# Workspaces and settings

Read and update the current workspace, list and create workspaces, and manage workspace settings (retention, spend cap, routing preferences, notification defaults). All of these need a session token plus `X-Workspace-ID`. For developers automating workspace administration.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary | Live example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/workspace`](#get-v1workspace) | Read the selected workspace settings | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/workspace`](#put-v1workspace) | Update the workspace name | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/settings/retention`](#get-v1settingsretention) | Read owner-controlled retention policy | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/settings/retention`](#put-v1settingsretention) | Update owner-controlled retention policy | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/workspace/retention`](#get-v1workspaceretention) | Read owner-controlled retention policy | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/workspace/retention`](#put-v1workspaceretention) | Update owner-controlled retention policy | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/settings/spend-cap`](#get-v1settingsspend-cap) | Read owner-controlled spend-cap policy | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/settings/spend-cap`](#put-v1settingsspend-cap) | Update owner-controlled spend-cap policy | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/workspace/spend-cap`](#get-v1workspacespend-cap) | Read owner-controlled spend-cap policy | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/workspace/spend-cap`](#put-v1workspacespend-cap) | Update owner-controlled spend-cap policy | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/settings/routing`](#get-v1settingsrouting) | Read workspace routing fallback consent | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/settings/routing`](#put-v1settingsrouting) | Explicitly enable or disable workspace route fallback | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/workspaces`](#get-v1workspaces) | List the current user's workspace memberships | yes |
| POST | [`/v1/workspaces`](#post-v1workspaces) | Create a sandbox workspace and owner membership | yes |
| GET | [`/v1/settings/notifications`](#get-v1settingsnotifications) | Read owner-controlled notification defaults | yes |
| PUT | [`/v1/settings/notifications`](#put-v1settingsnotifications) | Set one owner-controlled notification default | yes |

### GET /v1/workspace

**Read the selected workspace settings**

Operation ID: `getWorkspace`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Active browser session and workspace membership required. Settings are workspace-wide, with no environment header required.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Workspace settings. | `application/json`: [CustomerWorkspace](schemas.md#customerworkspace) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/workspace" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

### PUT /v1/workspace

**Update the workspace name**

Operation ID: `updateWorkspace`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner or admin browser session required. All other fields are rejected. Financial, routing and verification settings cannot be changed here.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

### GET /v1/settings/retention

**Read owner-controlled retention policy**

Operation ID: `getSettingsRetention`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner browser session only. Workspace-wide policy. Changing retention persists policy and does not itself prove redaction has run. Lowering spend cap preserves existing reservations.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Current policy. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` | integer | yes |  | Constraints: minimum `1`, maximum `400`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/settings/retention" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "days": 30
}
```

### GET /v1/settings/spend-cap

**Read owner-controlled spend-cap policy**

Operation ID: `getSettingsSpendCap`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner browser session only. Workspace-wide amount in workspace currency. Lowering the cap preserves existing reservations. Prospective typed live number purchases, renewals and sender registration fees count alongside message and lookup usage. Fee conversions freeze the original cycle and FX rate; linked refunds reduce that original cycle. Historical unquoted fees are not retroactively included.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Current policy. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | string \| null | yes |  | Constraints: pattern `^(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/settings/spend-cap" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "amount": null
}
```

### GET /v1/settings/routing

**Read workspace routing fallback consent**

Operation ID: `getRoutingSettings`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires an active owner or admin session and explicit workspace selection. Fallback defaults to false.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |

### PUT /v1/settings/routing

**Explicitly enable or disable workspace route fallback**

Operation ID: `updateRoutingSettings`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Updates consent and the optional pinned provider for future messages atomically with an audit record and event. The pinned provider must exist with an active status and is only preferred when eligible; it never bypasses eligibility. Existing queued messages retain their accepted routing policy. API keys cannot change this setting.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_fallback` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `pinned_provider_id` | string (uuid) \| null | no |  | Pin route selection to this provider |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

Object constraints: minProperties `1`.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Saved routing settings | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | Missing workspace or invalid payload | No body |
| `401` | Active session required | No body |
| `403` | Owner or admin membership required | No body |
| `422` | Pinned provider does not exist or is not usable | No body |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_fallback` | boolean | yes |  |  |
| `pinned_provider_id` | string (uuid) \| null | yes |  |  |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X PUT "$OPENSMS_API/v1/settings/routing" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"allow_fallback":true}'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "allow_fallback": true,
  "pinned_provider_id": null
}
```

### GET /v1/workspaces

Operation ID: `listCustomerWorkspaces`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Session only. No selected workspace or environment header is required. Returns current memberships in nondeleted workspaces ordered by creation time and ID descending. Cursors are bound to the authenticated user.

### POST /v1/workspaces

**Create a sandbox workspace and owner membership**

Operation ID: `createCustomerWorkspace`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Session only. Requires name and an active registration country. Name is trimmed and must contain no control characters. Country determines currency. Creates owner membership, both environment wallets and onboarding states atomically; verified email status carries over. No email is sent. Exact normalized request replay returns the original 201 snapshot. Changed input returns 409; a redacted or deleted or no-longer-accessible original workspace returns 410 without creating another workspace. No selected workspace header is required.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | At most 200 bytes. Bound to this authenticated user. Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |
| `country_iso2` | string | yes |  | Active registration country ISO2. Normalized to uppercase. Constraints: pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2}$`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Original workspace creation snapshot. Initially owner role with sandbox live status and pending KYC. | `application/json`: [WorkspaceMembership](schemas.md#workspacemembership) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `409` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `410` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `422` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/workspaces" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-fe81d883-64fd-4998-8d25-9cc6f9c9c330' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Acme Ghana","country_iso2":"GH"}'
```

Response `201` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "id": "190a0142-8466-4dcd-944e-79e8996f792a",
  "name": "Acme Ghana",
  "country_iso2": "GH",
  "currency": "GHS",
  "role": "owner",
  "live_status": "sandbox",
  "kyc_status": "pending",
  "created_at": "2026-09-24T07:40:18.735132+03:00"
}
```
